gaps.gap: No general command/tasking inference is supported; CNCCFP and Bundestag controls explicitly preserve a higher evidentiary threshold.
No examined source provides a causal design identifying persuasion or a changed electoral result attributable to the foreign-origin financing.
Cross-country rules are not isomorphic and do not by themselves establish prevalence of circumvention.
Legality under the old framework does not establish absence or presence of political consideration.
Tasking, quid-pro-quo and electoral effect are not established by the loan record examined.
The final judicial finding was unidentified donor/impermissible party donation, not foreign-state tasking.
A financing-law breach may exist without proving political command or corrupt exchange.
No matched exposure/persuasion/counterfactual design is present in the examined corpus.
Tasking/quid-pro-quo, persuasion and counterfactual result remain open even where source/vehicle/transfer/control are verified.
